name: Recommended risk-guided staged operational policy
scope: Interpolation within n=20-100 and m=5-20 for the documented GA architecture and parameter grid.

risk_signal.note: Historical evidence determines risk ordering and search breadth; the staged replication schedule is the lower-cost operational refinement evaluated on the 24-target panel.

GREEN.search_region: transferred center plus available +/-1 axial grid neighbors

AMBER.search_region: +/-1 Cartesian neighborhood around transferred center, at most 27 configurations

selection.stage1_ranking: mean Cmax ascending; deterministic tie-break (pop_mult, pc, pm) ascending
selection.final_selection: lowest confirmation-only mean Cmax; same deterministic tie-break

validation.evidence_status: descriptive matched-budget validation, not a prespecified confirmatory endpoint

original_prospective_validation.AMBER: local neighborhood Stage-1 R=3, raw top 5 extended to R=10, at most 116 runs
original_prospective_validation.role: basis of original confirmatory 21/24 policy-versus-center analysis
